title: Enhancing Project Financial Performance Prediction: An Explainable Machine Learning Framework Integrating Frontier Efficiency and Super Learner
core_idea: Incorporate frontier operational efficiency quantified via data envelopment analysis (DEA) as an input alongside traditional financial ratios into an explainable machine learning pipeline, using a super learner ensemble (random forest and CatBoost base models with a linear regression meta-learner) to predict project financial performance in an emerging market context.
tldr: Use DEA-measured operational efficiency plus financial ratios in an explainable super learner (RF + CatBoost base learners, linear meta-learner) to predict project financial performance in an emerging market.
